newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEPCO awards March LSWR to Yukong, Petrodiamond.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO awards March LSWR to Yukong, Petrodiamond.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) has awarded its tender to buy two 500,000-barrel cargoes of March low sulphur waxy residue to two North Asian traders, industry sources said on Friday.
Traders said a cargo for delivery March 11-15 was awarded to Japanese trader, Petrodiamond Corp, at $1.87 per barrel over Singapore spot quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The second cargo for delivery March 27-31 was awarded to South Korean refiner Yukong Ltd at $2.23 per barrel over the average of published quotes for the previous month, also on a c-and-f basis.
Both cargoes have an option for delivery to the ports of Ulsan or Pusan.
The tender closed Janaury 31 and was valid until February 1.
